summary: Revalidated Rio Tinto's sponsored ADR against issuer-published 2025 full-year financials, Q2 2026 production results, and current 2026-07-27 market and FX data. Oyu Tolgoi and diversified production are growing, but 2025 free cash flow fell 28% and net debt rose 162%. At the USD 91.95 mark, bounded 12-month scenarios based on 10x and 13x 2025 underlying EPS imply 27.2% downside and 5.4% base-case downside. The medium-confidence security is baseline eligible but uncompetitive with cash; the margin-of-safety gate and pending relationship review preclude a conviction strategy follow-up.

evidence.claim: The issuer reported USD 57.638 billion revenue, USD 25.363 billion underlying EBITDA, USD 16.832 billion operating cash flow, USD 4.025 billion free cash flow, USD 10.868 billion underlying earnings, USD 6.692 underlying EPS, and USD 14.362 billion net debt for 2025. The issuer page returned HTTP 200 on 2026-07-27.

First-half copper-equivalent production rose 3%, Oyu Tolgoi first-half production rose 31%, group second-quarter copper production was 213 kt and fell 7% year over year and sequentially, and full-year copper guidance remained 800-870 kt. The issuer page returned HTTP 200 on 2026-07-27.
